text: Redington has built a family of digital platforms.
Services as a Platform. Eight platforms, built and run in-house, with one purpose.
DNT Onboarding: live in six to ten days.
CloudQuarks, our cloud and AI marketplace.
RACE, our AI Centre of Excellence.
And MAAS, marketing as a service.
But each one was built separately. Its own login, its own data.
So we're bringing them all together.
One login, one profile, one wallet, one feed.
Every platform becomes a module, built on shared services and one master record, rolled out in three phases, from single sign-on to one front door.
Every platform connects the same way: one login, one record, one wallet and events, and one front door.
One identity. One record. One experience. Many platforms. One Redington.
